fusions.name: Snare Cast
fusions.desc: Casts a bolt that hits the first enemy in its path for 12 damage, stuns it for 1 second and leaves it [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Haul Line
fusions.desc: Hauls in every enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 30 damage to each and leaving it [Slowed] for 4 seconds. The blow ignores their elemental resistances.

fusions.name: Gathered Slack
fusions.desc: A challenge that pulls up to 5 enemies within 8 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Closing Mesh
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, your damage rises by 12%.
